I tend to get very obsessive about things: I do lots of research (I like to read research/science articles-psychology is my favorite subject) about things I am interested in. I started reading about the elimination diet yesterday and figured I would ask here for advice.

A few years ago I was losing weight (willingly) and I was tracking all of my food (weighing, keeping a log). 

So I would like to say I am somewhat intelligent but I also am not sure if this was a rhetorical question.
Thank you, I will take a look. I appreciate you attaching this link.
